# Obsidian Labs Software

> Software development studio in Bloemfontein, Free State, South Africa. We design and build websites, mobile applications and business systems for owner-led companies — hospitality, property, legal, healthcare, retail and dining. Operated by Continental Obsidian Ltd.

Canonical site: https://continentalobsidian.netlify.app
Contact: continentalobsidian@gmail.com

## Key pages
- [Home](https://continentalobsidian.netlify.app/): services, selected work and studio principles
- [Services](https://continentalobsidian.netlify.app/services): websites, applications and business systems
- [Industries](https://continentalobsidian.netlify.app/industries): hospitality, real estate, legal, healthcare, retail, dining
- [Exhibition](https://continentalobsidian.netlify.app/exhibition): six industry concept templates
- [Portfolio](https://continentalobsidian.netlify.app/portfolio): 100 working website and app templates across ten industry groups
- [About](https://continentalobsidian.netlify.app/about): the studio, approach and location
- [Contact](https://continentalobsidian.netlify.app/contact): project enquiries

## Notes
- All exhibition and portfolio brands are illustrative concept work, not client claims.
- Project enquiries are handled by email; there is no public pricing list.
